data.one_liner: Displays styled alert snackbars and material banners with failure, success, help, or warning types.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customized widget that can be used inside a standard SnackBar or MaterialBanner to display rich alert messages with unique UI designs, icons, and colors for success, failure, warning, and help states.
use_when: You want to display visually appealing snackbars or material banners for user feedback.
You need distinct styles for success, error, warning, and help messages.
avoid_when: You want simple, plain text snackbars without custom icons or multi-colored cards.
You need a totally custom notification system that doesn't rely on Flutter's built-in SnackBar or MaterialBanner.
strengths: Pre-designed UI variants for success, failure, help, and warning messages.
Supports both SnackBar and MaterialBanner widgets.
Supports RTL languages and desktop/tablet responsiveness.
weaknesses: Limited to snackbar and material banner use cases.
Relies on Flutter's built-in ScaffoldMessenger behavior.
data.setup_notes: Simply add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package.

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer floating toast notifications with highly customizable styles and animations.

alternatives.name: bot_toast
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a comprehensive toast and notification manager that can display custom widgets anywhere on screen.

alternatives.name: another_flushbar
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want feature-rich flushbars with buttons, indicators, and custom layouts.
